entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments:
CHAP. V. 
 
  An humble prayer, presenting to the Lord their great misery, ver. 1-15.   Confessing their sins, ver. 16-18.   Imploring deliverance, ver. 19-22.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: V. 3. We-We are all of us without a king, (our common father) we are deprived of thy fatherly protection, and many young children among us are left without an earthly parent.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: V.4. Sold-Whereas at other times there was abundance of wood and water throughout Judea.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: V. 6. We-The ten tribes were all carried captives into Assyria, and many of the kingdom of Judah fled into Egypt. Giving the hand may signify labouring for them: or, yielding up themselves to their power.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: V. 7. Their iniquities-The punishment of them.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: V. 9. The sword-The enemies lay encamped in all the plains, so that they could stir out no way but the sword of the Chaldeans was upon them.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: V. 13. Fell-Not being able to stand under the burdens laid upon them.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: V. 16. The crown-All our honour, splendor and dignity.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: V. 19. Thy throne-Altho' for our sins thou sufferest our throne to be cast down, yet thou art the same, thy power is not diminished, nor thy goodness abated.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: V. 21. Renew-Restore us to our former estate.
